sources.h1: Updated Pedal: Cosmic Terror Sonic Doom V4 Fuzz
sources.excerpt: Updated Jun. 25, 2025 | by Paolo De Gregorio Guitarists with a knack for sonic devastation should check out the C osmic Terror Sonic Doom , a fuzz that delivers extreme loudness, razor-sharp string articulation, and endless sustain—without feedback, muddiness, or low-end loss. Designed for musicians who want to push their amps to the limit, it thrives with clean guitar/bass amps or even direct into a power amp. Controls: Gravity: Adjusts fuzz/sustain—from overdrive-like tones at lower settings to infinite sustain at max. Sonority: Shapes the fuzz character, from desert-rock grit to screaming distortion. Focus: Tightens mids, ranging from Big Muff thickness to a mid-heavy punch. Master: A brutally loud volume control—handle with care! The V3 edition addsed enhanced low-end, supporting 9V/18V for maximum headroom, for extreme loudness. Each pedal features a chemically etched, black-patina enclosure with a hand-oiled finish for a unique look, while the new V4 adds soft click footswitch and a glossy and smooth finish. Produced in limited yearly batches, the Sonic Doom is built to order.
